field_principles.field_principles: Each top-level field has one plain-language purpose.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every failed check keeps its expected and observed value.
field_principles.harmful_memory_count: A positive count proves observed harmful memory cases exist.
field_principles.headroom_summary: Overall and stratum counts preserve zero and nonzero controls.
field_principles.helpful_memory_count: A positive count proves observed useful memory cases exist.

field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum binds stable content and excludes wall time.
field_principles.risk_sensitive_stream_ready_score: Exp6854 consumes this fully conjunctive fixture gate.
field_principles.rows: Each row joins one decision, one observed action, and one exact later outcome.
field_principles.run_date: The supplied date fixes the execution boundary.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema prevents silent fixture reinterpretation.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the exact evidence bytes.
field_principles.status: Status distinguishes complete construction from a blocked gate.
field_principles.title: The title states that this artifact contains opportunities, not a learner.
